full_test_suite.detail: All six failing cases also fail on the 0.16.0 code (cloud sync tag, Drive scheduling, two short-window planning layouts, one organizer search); four of them also fail at API 24. No failure is new since 0.16.0. Two obsolete Today command-row tests are skipped.

changes: propose_change tool on phone and web: complete a task, update a task (title, due date, new steps), add to a note, move an appointment
Changes are validated against the live record and write nothing until the user applies them in the review dialog
Applying is idempotent: tasks stay done and are logged once, steps and note text are added once, reminders keep their distance from a moved appointment
Each change needs its own access category; change proposals are never cached or replayed on Continue
Applied change cards open the changed record and sync with existing approval markers
known_limits: No physical handset; external model/search traffic simulated.
Providers/endpoints must support streaming tool calls; free-provider availability is external to Pocket.
Agent runs are foreground requests; interrupted work resumes only through the user Continue action.
Provider keys stay on each device; browser keys remain per tab.
Cloud storage has not gained end-to-end encryption.
